  PROBLEM: The fragment describes a two-field `skip=<pr>:<head>` entry, but the code writes a different form. `tick_skip3=1` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh line 1928) and `tm_skip3=1` (line 2321) are set because scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh defines `_merge_lease_skips_hard`/`_merge_lease_skips_soft` (lines 2950-2962). The tick therefore writes the three-field entry `<pr>:<sha>:revoked_hold_label`, and the tests now expect it (`[f"4:{_sha(4)}:revoked_hold_label"]`, `[f"6:{_sha(6)}:revoked_hold_label"]`). The entry is hard: `_merge_lease_skips_soft` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2960) keeps only `NF == 2 || $3 == "revoked_no_head_gate"`, and `_merge_lease_skip_is_soft` (line 2945) agrees.
  WHY: The code is unaffected, but the fragment is folded into agents.md as the contract. It gives the wrong record format and hides that the entry is hard, so a PR whose hold label is removed without a push stays skipped until its head changes. Suggested fix: change the text to "a `skip=<pr>:<head>:revoked_hold_label` (hard) entry".
- ERROR PATHS (verified OK, no finding): `none,` gives no entries. `off,ai:needs-human` keeps only the real label. A bare `none`, `off` or `''` returns early. `revoked_hold_label` revokes at once, because the run check at review_merge_train.sh lines 2053 and 2353 applies only to `revoked_no_head_gate`.

  WHY: Suggested fix is to add `"none,"` and `" NONE , OFF "`; both should still grant pr=5 and keep holder pr=4 with `reason=holder_open`. Estimated 1 line changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.

  PROBLEM: The fragment has three documentation gaps versus the implementation:
  (1) It describes the legacy two-field `skip=<pr>:<head>`, but the library writes the three-field `<pr>:<head>:<reason>` form (since #9983). `LeaseHoldLabels.test_hold_labelled_holder_is_revoked` and `LeaseHoldLabels.test_multi_holder_revokes_a_hold_labelled_secondary` in `tests/test_merge_lease.py` assert `<pr>:<sha>:revoked_hold_label`.
  (2) It does not state that `revoked_hold_label` is HARD per `_merge_lease_skips_soft` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2957-2960`).
  (3) It does not document the per-entry `none`/`off` drop (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3603-3604`).
  WHY: `scripts/assemble_agents.py` folds the fragment into `agents.md`. The assembled docs will then misstate the skip format, hide the hard/soft behavior, and miss the in-list off-token rule. Only the docs are affected; there is no runtime failure.
- HARDENING: tests/test_merge_lease.py, `LeaseHoldLabels.test_off_switch_restores_the_old_behaviour`, the value tuple at the top of the method
  PROBLEM: No test exercises the per-entry `none`/`off` skip (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3603-3604`). The tuple `("none", "", " OFF ")` covers only the whole-value branch. If the per-entry skip regressed, `"none,"` would print `"none"` as a literal hold-label name.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to extend the tuple to `("none", "", " OFF ", "none,", " NONE , OFF ")`; the existing assertions already cover the new values. Estimated 1 line changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
